titre.texte: Industrial case – aeronautique: analysis and improvement

contexte.texte:
Dear Professor,
[ENTREPRISE_A] is a 300-employee subsidiary producing carbon-fibre interior panels and cabin brackets for regional aircraft. Our plant is located in the [SITE_1].

objectifs.texte: We would like a team of students to perform a root cause analysis, build a statistical model linking curing parameters to porosity, and propose an updated work instruction for the lay-up operators.

donnees.texte: first-pass yield on autoclave-cured panels dropped from 93% to 84%

contraintes.texte: any process change must remain compliant with EN 9100 and be approved by our customer's quality team
Students cannot access the clean room without a 2-day training
The project must be delivered by June 2027

consignes.texte: Work in teams of 4 to 5 students.
Support every proposal with data from the case.
Comply with every listed constraint.
